title: Nest Protect Pathlight Night Frequency
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nestprotect:event event=pathlight
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=22 OR hour<6
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as pathlight_events by location _time
| sort - pathlight_events
description: Uses Nest Protect pathlight events telemetry to monitor how often nighttime movement triggers hallway lighting in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for rooms with more night traffic than expected, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nest Protect pathlight events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Weekly location chart of pathlight events.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how often nighttime movement triggers hallway lighting so you can spot rooms with more night traffic than expected before it becomes annoying.
